text:
emily park: Hey team, quick one. Took a taxi from LHR to client site last night and the driver didn’t give a printed receipt. Card shows a charge 'TAXI LHR 42.00' on my personal card. Need to get reimbursed for $42 — can I submit the bank screenshot instead?
ben (travel-ops): Sorry that happened. Can you upload the bank transaction screenshot + last4 of the card used and any photo of the taxi or plate? If you have a ride app note or driver SMS that helps.
emily park: uploading bank_screenshot.jpg and a fuzzy photo of the taxi with plate. last4 = 1122. I messaged the driver and got a short sms: "fare 42"  uploaded sms_screenshot.jpg. This was client-facing meeting with Dena from Ops.
dena (manager): Confirming client meeting at 9:30 with Helix Labs. Emily was required to be onsite. I approve reimbursement for the taxi fare; manager attests driver couldn't provide a receipt. Approving priority if that helps. :white_check_mark:
reimburse-bot: Expense flagged: MISSING_RECEIPT. Policy note: taxis require itemized receipt when available. Exceptions accepted with manager attestation + supplemental proof (photo or bank trace). Please include manager approval in-thread.
susan (finance): Hi Emily 10. We can make an exception given manager approval and the evidence you uploaded. Policy cap for non-itemized taxi exceptions is $50. We need a 1-sentence statement from you: "why receipt unavailable and confirmation trip was client-facing." Also choose payout method: standard reimbursement (3-5 business days) or payroll advance (next payroll run ~7 days).
emily park: statement: "Driver had no terminal and could not reprint a receipt; trip was client-facing for Helix Labs kickoff." I need funds sooner than 7 days — is the standard 3 days guaranteed?
susan (finance): Standard 3-5 days. Since Dena approved priority here, we can mark as PRIORITY and aim for 2 business days. Confirm you want priority reimbursement (we'll mark FIN-9123-P).
emily park: Yes please priority reimbursement. Thank you.
dena (manager): Marking priority. Pls expedite — team depends on Emily this week.
susan (finance): Marked PRIORITY and queued FIN-9123-P. Expected settlement 2 business days. Note for audit: we'll retain sms_screenshot, taxi photo, bank trace, and manager approval. If any additional proof is requested, Finance will DM.
emily park: Amazing, really appreciate the quick turnaround. :relieved:
